title: ✍️ Writing Mini-Test

sections.heading: Instructions
sections.body: This test covers writing strategies from all Writing lessons. Questions test your understanding of structure, vocabulary, grammar, and task requirements.

highlight: Task Achievement is the most important criterion — always answer the WHOLE question.

question: A Task 2 question asks: "To what extent do you agree that social media has had a negative impact on young people? Discuss and give your opinion." You write only about negative impacts. What mark will this lose?
options: Nothing — the question says negative impact
Task Achievement — you missed the "extent" requirement
correct: Task Achievement — you missed the "extent" requirement
explanation:
"To what extent" = How much? Partially? Fully? Not at all?

You must state your DEGREE of agreement — not just describe negatives.

A full answer: "While social media has several negative effects, I believe these are often overstated, and its benefits for connectivity and information access are considerable."

sentence: Task 2 requires a minimum of _______ words. Task 1 requires a minimum of _______ words.
explanation:
Task 1: 150+ words (20 minutes recommended)
Task 2: 250+ words (40 minutes recommended)

Writing fewer words automatically drops Task Achievement/Task Response. Always check your count before finishing.

question: Which Task 2 conclusion is Band 8+?
options: In conclusion, I think technology is good.
In conclusion, this essay has discussed technology.

In conclusion, despite the concerns outlined above, the transformative potential of technology — particularly in widening educational access — ultimately outweighs its drawbacks, provided that robust regulatory frameworks are established.
To conclude, technology has advantages and disadvantages as I have shown.
correct: In conclusion, despite the concerns outlined above, the transformative potential of technology — particularly in widening educational access — ultimately outweighs its drawbacks, provided that robust regulatory frameworks are established.
explanation:
✅ Band 8+ conclusion:
• "despite the concerns outlined above" — references the essay structure
• "transformative potential" — sophisticated noun phrase
• "particularly in widening educational access" — specific example
• "provided that" — conditional clause showing nuance
• No: "In this essay I have shown" (meta-commentary)
• No: "I think" (informal)
